parameters.name: DtsInstanceId
parameters.description:
The dynamic part in the error message. This parameter is used to replace the **%s** variable in the **ErrMessage** parameter.

>  If the return value of the **ErrMessage** parameter is **The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid** and the return value of the **DynamicMessage** parameter is **DtsJobId**, the specified **DtsJobId** parameter is invalid.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task.

parameters.name: JobType
parameters.description:
The type of the Data Transmission Service (DTS) task. Valid values:

*   **MIGRATION**: data migration task
*   **SYNC**: data synchronization task
*   **SUBSCRIBE**: change tracking task

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The error code returned if the call failed.

parameters.name: SynchronizationDirection
parameters.description: The dynamic error code. This parameter will be removed in the future.

parameters.name: ZeroEtlJob
parameters.description:
Whether it is a seamless integration (Zero-ETL) task, the value can be:
- **false**: No. - **true**: Yes.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts delete-dts-job --dts-job-id l3m1213ye7l0000 --dts-instance-id dtsl3m1213ye7l0000 --synchronization-direction Forward --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --job-type MIGRATION --zero-etl-job true --resource-group-id rg-aek26lwshij0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts DeleteDtsJob --region cn-hangzhou --DtsJobId l3m1213ye7l0000 --JobType MIGRATION --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aek26lwshij0000' --ZeroEtlJob true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DtsInstanceId dtsl3m1213ye7l0000 --SynchronizationDirection Forward
